primary_model.name: csr_lanl_identity_hgb
primary_model.selection_reason: Best validation PR-AUC/F1 among available folds, with stable test behavior.

argos_policy.recommended_use: Prioritization and enrichment. Do not create automatic incidents without SIEM correlation.

required_input.format: CSV, JSONL, or Parquet rows already transformed to the CSR-LANL identity feature contract
notes: This package scores feature windows. It does not parse raw Wazuh events directly.
ARGOS must provide the same 209 feature columns used during training.
Missing required features are treated as schema errors.
